cds.title: Carleton College Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF, Institutional Research and Assessment)

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs for the full 2026-27 year from the Common Data Set (G1, G5): tuition $75,186, required fees $486, on-campus housing $10,194 + food $9,120 = $19,314. Estimated expenses: books $1,101, transportation $850, other $939 (other costs shown = transportation + other). Carleton's admissions page lists a 2026-27 comprehensive fee (tuition, housing, food, activity fee) of $94,980 and its international-students page an estimated cost of attendance of $104,746. Institutional need-based aid is available to nonresidents; 63 degree-seeking nonresidents received institutional aid (average $81,596; total $5,140,528).

stats.notes: Fall 2025 entering class (Common Data Set 2025-2026). Residency rows (in-state 636 / out-of-state 2,870 / international 3,290 applicants; 221 / 1,127 / 132 admits; 88 / 376 / 54 enrolled) add up to the totals. International (nonresident) first-years: 54 enrolled. The ED figures cover Early Decision (binding; the CDS does not split first and second round); the CDS text labels them 'Fall 2024 entering class', but they differ from Carleton's 2024-2025 CDS (667 applied, 244 admitted), so they are the Fall 2025 counts. Carleton reported no high-school GPA data (C11/C12 blank), so the GPA fields are empty. Class rank was reported for 30.5% of enrolled first-years: 77% top tenth, 94% top quarter, 100% top half. Undergraduate enrollment (1,974) and the nonresident count (201) are the CDS 'Total Undergraduates' figures. SAT/ACT submission is optional (permanent test-optional policy): 39.4% of enrolled first-years submitted SAT, 24.7% ACT.
